Ananya Sharma secured All India Rank 13 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025 , placing her among the top performers in this year’s merit list. Her achievement reflects disciplined preparation, conceptual clarity, and consistent performance across all three stages of the Civil Services Examination—Prelims, Mains, and the Personality Test.
Ananya Sharma completed her schooling from Daly College, Indore, where she built a strong academic foundation. She later pursued B.A. (Hons.) in Economics from Hindu College, University of Delhi.
Her academic background in economics provided a strong analytical base that supported her preparation for the Civil Services Examination
During her UPSC preparation journey, Ananya Sharma was associated with VisionIAS Abhyaas Prelims and the Personality Development Program .
These programmes supported her preparation through exam-like testing, revision-oriented practice, and structured guidance for the interview stage of the Civil Services Examination.

Ananya Sharma cleared the UPSC Civil Services Examination in her third attempt , securing AIR 13 in UPSC CSE 2025. Her journey reflects persistence, structured preparation, and steady improvement across attempts.
Through disciplined revision, regular test practice, and focused preparation for the Personality Test, she was able to strengthen her performance across the different stages of the examination.

For the UPSC Civil Services Mains Examination, Ananya Sharma chose Sociology as her optional subject . Sociology helped her develop a deeper understanding of social structures, institutions, and contemporary social issues, which also complemented the General Studies papers.
Since the optional subject carries 500 marks in UPSC Mains, it plays an important role in determining the final rank in the Civil Services Examination.
The UPSC CSE 2025 marks of Ananya Sharma will be released by the Union Public Service Commission along with the marks of recommended candidates.
